scope: Historical completed experiments; snapshot of existing summaries, not a new model evaluation. Means across layers pool counts within each layer first. Three seeds, equal weight.

sweep.primary_contrast: F minus A at 4K sampled accuracy
sweep.interpretation: Three paired training seeds; df=2 t interval assumes approximately normal seed differences. All other contrasts descriptive.

scope.scope: A update40 BF16 HF checkpoint, captured rollout40. Same weights and batches for replay and current balancing counts. Native A pack/token objective; no policy or z backward contribution; no optimizer step. Router vectors and full group norms, no dense gradient dumps. This tests local count-source sensitivity, not historical FP32 optimizer reproduction.

padding_probe.scope: Same endpoint weights, rollout59 responses and replay. Local-batch maximum padding, native absent mask versus direct correct router mask; no optimizer steps. Unpadded reference is a separate execution. Gradient/moment projections describe geometry, not causal optimizer history.

completed_followup_endpoints.scope: Same evaluator image and invocation verified. Summary-level seed comparisons; no new prompt bootstrap.
completed_followup_endpoints.uncertainty: Paired training-seed t intervals are descriptive and imprecise with n=3; single seeds get no seed interval.

checks: Every local audited record equals its official score/token/cap/id/sample record in order
Every category count reproduces audit summary
Every six-category contrast sums exactly to accuracy-count difference
Frozen scorer source hashes equal original audit
Final immutable manifest hash matches runtime manifest
